correctness.rationale: From the published cyclic facet formula the verifier reconstructs 14 vertices, 42 edges, and 28 faces; proves flagness by complete clique enumeration; computes a 28-by-29 tree-contracted integral \(H_1\) presentation of rank 28 whose maximal minors have gcd 2; checks mod-two relation rank 27; and exhausts every simple cycle of lengths three and four. All 28 three-cycles are face boundaries. Of 77 four-cycles, exactly 42 are null, 21 have zero free coordinate but nonzero mod-two residue and hence are the unique torsion class, and 14 have free coordinate of absolute value 1 and hence primitive infinite order. The three translation orbits have sizes 14, 7, and 14 and exhaust the 35 essential cycles.

value.rationale: The object is a canonical small symmetric Klein-bottle triangulation: Datta--Upadhyay identify \(Q_{7,2}\) as the only weakly regular member among their seven listed small degree-regular Klein-bottle cases. Later work independently treats 14 vertices as the computational frontier for flag Klein-bottle triangulations. The complete minimum-length integral-homology spectrum distinguishes torsion from primitive free classes by exact multiplicity and symmetry orbit, giving structural information about how the two summands of \(H_1\) are realized combinatorially rather than an arbitrary finite statistic.
